scientific_scope: Internal open-arena development estimation only. This authorization does not constitute external validation or canonical promotion.
tested_to_clean_head_relation: The Chromium-tested estimator/UI state and merged estimator are byte-identical for the pinned estimator/runtime/model inputs. The clean PR head differed from the tested workflow-bearing head only by deletion of the temporary audit workflow.

authorized_frozen_execution.primary_survival_guard: H5-context beats H5-null in at least 5 of 6 held-out folds and has strictly positive median relative improvement.
authorized_frozen_execution.development_preferred_guard: H5-context beats the per-fold best frozen H2/H3/H4 comparator in at least 4 of 6 folds and has strictly positive median relative improvement versus that comparator.

execution_firewall: Do not change parameter bounds, nuisance definitions, Halton mapping, candidate counts, trial counts, seeds, physics dt, objective metrics, objective weights, fold membership, or promotion thresholds.
Do not add baseline speed as a nuisance parameter.
Do not fit moving speed, moving distance, straightness, raw heading diagnostics, or any threshold-dependent metric.
Do not refit H2, H3, or H4; only re-evaluate their frozen fold candidates.
Do not access or use Y-maze data, outcomes, or simulations for model selection.
Do not change the H5 runtime/model or any pinned scorer/reference/comparator input.
Do not run an adaptive second stage or favorable-seed rerun.
official_execution_rule: Authorize one official execution of the frozen high-resolution H5-v1 procedure. A rerun is permitted only if the first execution is formally declared invalid because of a genuine implementation/infrastructure error; the complete frozen procedure must then be rerun unchanged.
post_result_rule: Freeze and record the complete result before any interpretation-driven code or policy change. Failure cannot be rescued by tuning H5-v1 harder.

authorization_gate_hardening.rule: When effective_when_merged_to_main is true, the estimator CLI rejects high-resolution execution unless the current execution branch is main.
authorization_gate_hardening.reason: Prevents the presence of this authorization file on its review branch from making the official search executable before merge.
